material dodo.dodo_layout.png: the texture's pieces in soft region colours, named: the bird's left side. The right side is the left mirrored, so paint each piece once.
material dodo.dodo_pieces.png: each texel's piece in the piece's colour (below), black where there is none: a mask for each piece. The layout is pinned (model.py: layout.json); draw.py stops if a piece's outline moves.
material dodo.dodo_regions.png: colour regions in the build's colours: red body, green face, blue beak, cyan forehead neck and feet, magenta hood, yellow wings and patterning; black is never dyed (eye, claws, inside of the mouth, tongue). The bars of the back and the tail bands are yours to paint as yellow.
material dodo.dodo_position.png: each texel's place on the bird at rest, (x left, y up, z forward) scaled from the box below to 0..1
material dodo.dodo_normal_object.png: the smooth surface normal in the bird's frame (x left, y up, z forward), 0.5 + 0.5 n
material dodo.dodo_feather_direction.png: which way the feathers lie, as a direction in the picture: red = 0.5 + 0.5 u, green = 0.5 + 0.5 v (v up the picture); blue 1 where it is defined (shell, wings, legs), 0 elsewhere
material dodo.dodo_curvature.png: grey 0.5 is flat; lighter bulges, darker hollows
material dodo.dodo_occlusion.png: ambient occlusion from the opaque surface alone, the cards left out
material dodo.dodo_occlusion_apart.png: the same with the wings and legs taken a metre out to their sides
material dodo.dodo_covered.png: white where a wing or a leg hides the surface at rest, or is the side of it that is hidden; compose.py takes the occlusion there from the bake apart

material dodo_cards.dodo_cards_layout.png: each kind of card and its rectangle; every card of a kind is drawn from it. Strips (hood, body, trousers, mane, forehead) hang from the top of their rectangle, roots up and tips down; tail and finger feathers stand root down, tip up. A strip's u runs along its length. The card is cut out by your alpha.
material dodo_cards.dodo_cards_regions.png: the region each rectangle belongs to; tail bands and any pale tips are yellow where you paint them
